name: Screenshot & Region Capture
purpose: Capture a monitor, a top-level window (by hwnd/pid/title), an application's main window (by process name), or an explicit screen rectangle to a PNG (or JPG) image artifact plus a contract-valid result envelope. The visual-capture complement to the UIA skills, for when structured inspection is unavailable (e.g. Unity/game windows expose no UIA tree) or visual verification is genuinely needed. Read-only; no window management or synthetic input.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Target <monitor|window|app|region> (inferred from locators if omitted); -Monitor <index|all|primary>; window locators -Hwnd <int> | -ProcessId <int> | -Title <glob>; -App <process-name glob>; region -X <int> -Y <int> -Width <int> -Height <int>; -Format <png|jpg>. OR -InputsJson '<json {target,monitor,hwnd,pid,title,app,x,y,width,height,format}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: monitor | window | app | region. Inferred from the supplied locator when omitted.

inputs.name: monitor
inputs.description: For target=monitor: a 0-based index, or 'all' (whole virtual desktop), or 'primary'.

inputs.name: hwnd
inputs.description: Window locator: target window handle (highest precedence).

inputs.name: pid
inputs.description: Window locator: capture the process's main window.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Window locator: glob match on a visible top-level window title (first match; warns if several).

inputs.name: app
inputs.description: For target=app: process-name glob (e.g. notepad, *chrome*); lowest matching pid that owns a main window.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Region left, in virtual-desktop pixel coordinates.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Region top, in virtual-desktop pixel coordinates.
